data.title: The Reason To Stop Buying New Hardware | Cascadia Research
data.description: The best AI model improves every quarter; the hardware to match last year’s best shrinks a hundredfold. A sourced, interactive argument that most AI infrastructure is a deflating asset: rent the frontier, own the trailing edge.
data.author: Not Community Labs Inc.
data.keywords: intelligence deflation, AI capex, model densification, GPU total cost of ownership, small language models
